dim empty seat back and worn chrome rail at the lower left of frame

shots.action: A locked camera holds on the interior face of a bus window at night, the glass filling most of the frame while a sliver of dim, empty seat back and worn chrome rail sit at the lower left. Outside the window the dark street dissolves into soft out-of-focus pools of amber and red light. Rain has already sheeted the pane: hundreds of beads cling to the surface, and a few heavy drops begin to drag downward, cutting clear lines through the film of condensation. The camera does not move; only the water travels, each streak wobbling slightly as it gathers mass and forks around an older trail. Rain drums steadily against the glass and the low, muffled thrum of the bus engine runs underneath it.
shots.what_changes: The beaded, condensation-filmed pane holds still while the first heavy droplets break loose and start cutting downward trails.

subjects: a single large droplet sliding down wet glass
the condensation haze of the window surface
out-of-focus threads of water moving alongside
a smaller bead being absorbed by the large droplet
sync_sound: rain tapping close on the glass
faint muffled engine hum behind the glass
shots.action: The shot cuts to an extreme close view of the same wet glass, the frame almost entirely filled by a single large droplet sliding down the pane. The droplet trembles at the head of its track, gathering smaller beads as it goes, swelling and darkening, and its curved surface carries a tiny inverted image of the streetlights outside. Behind it the condensation haze glows faintly and other threads of water slide past out of focus, their motion slow and viscous. Near the end of the shot the droplet meets a slower bead, hesitates, and pulls it into itself, then continues down and out of the bottom of the frame. The rain's patter is louder and closer here, each impact a soft tap on the pane.
shots.what_changes: The featured droplet swells as it absorbs a smaller bead, then accelerates and exits the bottom of frame.

subjects: the full bus window, heavily streaked with long rivulets
passing headlights smearing into amber and white bars beyond the glass
the dark interior and a chrome rail with a thin trembling highlight
fresh water sheeting down the upper corner of the pane
sync_sound: even rain patter against the glass
shots.action: The shot transitions to a wider, slightly higher view of the whole window again, the pane now heavily streaked with long wavering rivulets. Beyond the glass, passing headlights bloom and smear into long amber and white bars that stretch and slide across the wet surface as the bus moves, their reflections dragging over the droplets and breaking into glitter at the edges of each bead. The interior stays dark and steady, the chrome rail catching one thin, trembling highlight. A fresh rush of water sheets down the upper corner of the pane and the streaks redraw themselves, the light bars continuing to slide and stretch until the frame settles into the same patient, closed-in stillness it began with. Rain continues its even patter, and the engine note sinks a little lower.
shots.what_changes: Outside light bars stretch and slide across the freshly streaked pane as new water sheets down the corner and redraws the trails.

description.text: The interior face of a bus window at night fills most of the frame, its glass beaded with rainwater and softened by a film of condensation.

Beyond the pane, the dark street dissolves into out-of-focus pools of amber and red light.
Hundreds of droplets cling to the surface, and a few heavy beads begin to drag downward, cutting clear, wavering lines through the condensation.
Each streak forks around older trails as it gathers mass.
Rain drums steadily against the glass, and a low muffled engine hum runs underneath.
The pane stays still while the water travels, and the first heavy droplets break loose and start cutting downward trails.
The window glass is beaded with rainwater and softened by condensation, with a dim seat back and worn chrome rail at the lower left.
Steady rain drums on the glass, with a low muffled engine hum underneath.
Several heavy droplets break loose and drag clear, wavering trails through the condensation.
Rain patter remains steady against the pane.
The camera holds a static shot.
An extreme close detail of the same wet glass is almost entirely filled by a single large droplet sliding down the pane.
The droplet trembles at the head of its track, gathering smaller beads as it goes, swelling and darkening.
Its curved surface carries a tiny inverted image of the streetlights outside.
Behind it the condensation haze glows faintly, and other threads of water slide past out of focus, their motion slow and viscous.
Near the end of the shot the droplet meets a slower bead, hesitates, and pulls it into itself, then continues down and out of the bottom of the frame.
Rain patter is louder and closer here, each impact a soft tap on the pane, with a faint engine hum behind the glass.
A single large droplet fills the close view, its surface carrying an inverted glint of streetlights.
Rain taps close and soft on the glass, with a faint engine hum behind it.
The droplet trembles, gathers smaller beads, and swells as it slides along its track.
The droplet meets a slower bead, absorbs it after a brief hesitation, and continues out of the bottom of frame.
The close rain patter continues without pause.

The whole bus window is visible again, the pane now heavily streaked with long wavering rivulets.
Beyond the glass, passing headlights bloom and smear into long amber and white bars that stretch and slide across the wet surface as the bus moves.
Their reflections drag over the droplets and break into glitter at the edges of each bead.
The interior stays dark and steady, the chrome rail catching one thin, trembling highlight.
A fresh rush of water sheets down the upper corner of the pane, and the streaks redraw themselves.
The light bars continue to slide and stretch until the scene settles into the same patient, closed-in stillness it began with.
Rain continues its even patter, and the engine note sinks a little lower.
The full window is heavily streaked with rivulets, and the dark interior holds a thin highlight on the chrome rail.
Even rain patter continues, and the engine note sinks lower.
Passing headlights bloom into amber and white bars that stretch and slide across the wet glass.
Fresh water sheets down the upper corner and redraws the streaked trails.
The rain keeps a steady patter as the frame settles into stillness.
The camera holds a static shot.
